title: Reading a work-tape action code
statement: Given a bit string, attempt to decode first an optional write instruction, consisting of an optional optional Boolean value, and then a head movement. If both decodings succeed, return the decoded pair together with the remaining suffix of the bit string; otherwise, return no result.
caveat: The decoding conventions and the precise number of bits consumed are determined by helper functions whose definitions are not supplied.
